name: plan_veto
description: Veto keeps a negative tilt and zeroes a positive one (plan tilt formula). The plan's lineage example prints tilt.equity.small = -0.101 for composite 33.3 and cap 0.30, but its own formula gives (33.3-50)/50*0.30 = -0.1002; the formula value is used and the discrepancy is listed in HANDOFF.md.
